description.en: Include run history. Default is false.

descriptions.zh:
## 请求说明
- 通过此 API 可以获取 PolarClaw 应用中的所有定时任务，或者根据 `JobIdList` 参数过滤特定的任务。
- 如果不提供 `JobIdList` 参数，则返回应用中的所有定时任务。
descriptions.en:
## Request description

- You can use this API to retrieve all scheduled tasks in a PolarClaw application or filter specific tasks using the `JobIdList` parameter.

- If you do not specify the `JobIdList` parameter, the API returns all scheduled tasks in the application.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb describe-polar-claw-cron-jobs --application-id pa-00000000000000 --job-id-list 0ee00f56-f467-4d41-858c-ca4ede2c770e --include-disabled true --include-runs true --run-limit 10 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb DescribePolarClawCronJobs --region cn-hangzhou --JobIdList '["0ee00f56-f467-4d41-858c-ca4ede2c770e"]' --IncludeDisabled true --ApplicationId 'pa-00000000000000' --RunLimit 10 --IncludeRuns true
